jobs.description:
Looking for a job that keeps you moving and pays great? 💸 As a Warehouse Employee at DPD in Joure, you’ll earn a top salary of €14.99 per hour. With extra shift bonuses, your hourly pay can even jump to €22.48! Whether you want to work 1 day or 3 days, you decide your own schedule. 🕒 Plus, you have the chance to land a permanent contract after just 12 weeks. Ready to join the team? Read on!

What we offer
- A salary of € 14.99 per hour💶
- Shift bonuses up to 50% (€22.48)
- Travel allowance🚗
- Weekly payments! 💸
- A permanent contract after 12 weeks
- A fun, international team of colleagues 🌍

Who you are
You are an energetic Warehouse Employee who loves to stay active. Since the work can be physically demanding, you see every shift as a free gym session! 💪 You work accurately and enjoy being part of a team that gets things done. Further, you meet the following points:

- You are at least 18 years old for safety reasons
- You are at least available on Saturday for the morning shifts (03:00 - 07:30)
- You are physically fit and ready to lift parcels up to 23 kg
- You understand the English or Dutch language
- You have your own transport to get to Joure

What will you do
As a Warehouse Employee, you are the heart of our logistics process. You start by unloading trucks full of packages. You make sure everything is moved onto the sorting belts smoothly. 📦 You scan the parcels so they head to the right destination. Lifting packages up to 23 kg keeps you fit while you earn money! It's productive work that gives you a real sense of achievement at the end of the day!

- Workdays between Monday to Saturday
- Morning shift: 03:00 to 07:30
- Afternoon shift: 16:00 to 19:30

Where will you work
You’ll be working at DPD in Joure, one of the most vibrant logistics hubs in the region. Here, being a Warehouse Employee means being part of a family. 🌟 We work hard to get those packages out on time. But there’s always room for a laugh during breaks. With a supportive team le

Do you want to work in a modern logistics environment? As an OPT driverr in Bergen op Zoom, you make sure goods are safely and quickly placed in the right spot in the warehouse. You work full-time, 40 hours per week, in a 2-shift system. In this job you can learn a lot and grow further.

Your workday starts with a short handover from the previous team. Then you get started right away. You drive a reach truck and help with loading and unloading products. You check orders and make sure everything stays tidy. You also work together with colleagues for a smooth process. You like to get things done and work safely and accurately.

Are you ready for a new challenge in logistics? Apply now and become part of an enthusiastic team! You get the chance to develop yourself and grow. Your effort is appreciated. 📦🚀

- You have a VMBO, MBO, or similar diploma
- You speak and understand English
- You have a valid OPT licence
- Experience as a reach truck operator is a plus, but not required
- You work accurately and safely
- You enjoy working in a 2-shift system

Working in a paradise of the most beautiful drinking glasses. 🥛 Yes! Get started quickly. And not to forget, earn well! As a production employee glass you earn € 19,90 if you work in two shifts. Katchinggg! 💸 LCG has shifts on the weekends as well. You choose which days you want to work. #Baanrader. What else do you want? Get to know more below! 👇

What we offer
- Hourly wage for working in 1 shift € 15,43!
- Earn € 19,90 if you work in 2 or more shifts!
- Career opportunities!
- A nice multicultural team!
- Choose your working days!
- Great teamwork in the warehouse!

Who you are
As a packing employee, you are physically fit to stand along the production line during your shift. Further, you fulfill the following requirements:

- You are available at least 3 days a week;
- You are at least 18 years old due to working hours;
- You have your own accommodation in the area of Leerdam;
- You speak English or Dutch;
- You are physically fit to pack the glasses at a fast pace;
- You can work at least in the night shift: 21:45-05:45;
- You can work preferably one other extra shift from: 05:45-13:45 or 13:45-21:45.

What will you do
As a packing employee you will work in the glass factory in Leerdam. You have your own place along the production line where you check the glasses for quality. ✨ You then pack them in boxes. 📦 You will receive instructions how exactly the glasses should be packed. After this, you stack the boxes on pallets. These boxes are picked up by your colleague with a forklift. This way, the glasses can be sent to IKEA on time. Let's go! 🚀

Where will you work
As a packing employee you find yourself in a paradise of glasses. You work in the factory of Leerdam Crisal Glass. IKEA glasses are produced here. Interesting to see! 😃 There is a nice, informal working atmosphere in the warehouse. There is always room for a chat during your work. That's why you quickly feel at home. 🤍 But of course we also work hard to send the glasses to the customer on tim

As a Service Delivery Employee in Venlo, you work 40 hours per week in the logistics sector. You are the link between customers, carriers, and your colleagues. You make sure everything runs smoothly and the customer is satisfied. You get a lot of responsibility and plenty of room to develop yourself.
On a regular workday, you manage the planning of incoming and outgoing goods. You solve delivery issues, handle administration, and keep in touch with international customers. You spot problems and actively think about improvements. Creating reports is also part of your job, as well as checking customs documents.
Do you see yourself as a problem-solver who likes to take initiative? Do you want to work in a lively, international environment where no day is the same? Apply today and make a difference as a Service Delivery Employee! 🚀

- Higher vocational education level (HBO), preferably in transport or logistics

- 1 to 5 years of relevant work experience

- Experience with international logistics and customs regulations

- Good command of the English language

- Proficient with Outlook, Excel, Word, and preferably TMS systems

- You are communicative, accurate, and solution-oriented

- Flexible, stress-resistant, independent, and a team player

When it’s time for a break, you can relax with a hot coffee or a refreshing drink, along with delicious sandwiches and soups from our fully stocked cafeteria.

As part of our team, you’ll experience a variety of tasks, from picking and packing orders to performing quality checks across different departments. Do you like to get things done? Do you want to work for a major player in logistics? At DSV in Tholen, you get the space to show your skills on the reach truck. You will join a friendly team that works hard. There is always time for a joke on the floor. The best part? You work in a fixed day shift. This means you are always home on time for your own plans in the evening.

- Great salary up to € 15,71 per hour!

Job application

As a warehouse employee at Zara in Maastricht, you work flexibly and part-time in the city center. You work 3 to 8 hours per week, spread over short shifts from 7:00 to 12:00 or 16:00 to 19:00. You earn a competitive salary of €14.99 per hour. This job is easy to combine with your studies or another job. You will join an enthusiastic and diverse team.
Your day starts with unpacking deliveries. You sort clothing and accessories and make sure everything is neatly stored in the right place in the warehouse. During your shift, you help keep the warehouse organized and ensure the store always has enough stock. You work together with colleagues and handle tasks independently. At the end of the shift, you help keep everything clean and tidy.
This job is ideal if you like to stay active and want variety in your work. No experience is needed, a good attitude is most important. Apply now and help keep logistics running smoothly in the center of Maastricht! ✨

- At least VMBO (secondary education) level of working and thinking

- No experience required, but it is a plus

- Able to work independently and in a team

- Physically fit and proactive

- You speak Dutch or English

Looking for a job where you stay active and earn a great salary? At GXO in Heerlen, you’ll work in a modern warehouse for well-known brands like Zara, H&M, Primark, IKEA, and Ahold. You make sure every order is ready on time.

As a warehouse worker, you keep everything running smoothly:

- Picking orders like clothing and shoes
- Packing items carefully and preparing them for shipment
- Helping to keep stock organized

You’ll work full-time in a 2-shift system (morning and afternoon). The schedule is clear and planned in advance, so you always know what to expect.

- You can speak and read English
- You have your own transport to GXO Heerlen
- You’re available fulltime in 2 shifts
- Experience in logistics is nice, but not required (GXO teach you everything)

As an order picker at AS Watson in Heteren, you’re always on the move. You collect products using a voice pick system: your headset tells you where to go, you grab the right product, and confirm it. You walk a lot, lift small and large packages, and make sure everything ends up in the right place. You work in a 2- or 3-shift system, depending on your preference. This means sometimes you start early, sometimes later, but you always have time for yourself. In this role as warehouse worker or logistics employee, you really make an impact: thanks to you, thousands of people can shop daily at Kruidvat, Trekpleister, and ICI Paris XL.

- You speak Dutch or English
- You can handle physical work
- You’re available to work at least one Saturday every four weeks
- You choose either a 2- or 3-shift system
- You live a maximum of 30 km from Heteren

You'll be part of an international team of colleagues from Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and the Netherlands, bringing together a wealth of experience and authentic culinary traditions. Excellent training and development opportunities through our Hai Academy. Great employee benefits, including discounts on sports memberships, products, days out and many other perks that support your wellbeing and work-life balance.

As a warehouse employee you are the heartbeat of our logistic process. You load and unload trucks at a good pace. This gives a great feeling of accomplishment when the job is done. Together with your team, you will sort and scan every package. The parcels will reach the customers on time with your help. Because the shifts are 5.5 hours, you stay energized and the time flies by. Work done!

- Afternoon shift: Monday to Friday from 16:00 to 21:30
- Night shift: Tuesday to Saturday from 02:00 to 07:30

Where will you work
Step into the energetic world of DPD in Meppel! Here, you join a friendly, international team. Working together feels like a team sport and the atmosphere scores a solid 8+! 🌟 As a logistics employee, you are part of a warm community.
